head: working-tree
subject: native gRPC response fallback interop regression

known_reference_differences: grpc-js maps DATA FIN without grpc-status to INTERNAL; netz applies the documented UNKNOWN fallback (netz=2 vs grpc-js=13 status observations).
grpc-js maps the HTML fixture body to RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED as an oversized message envelope; netz discards the non-gRPC entity (netz=2 vs grpc-js=8).

notes: Re-ran the independent HTTP/2 peer plus official grpc-js response-policy matrix on the current tree after the HTTP/1, HTTP/2, QUIC and MQTT changes. The matrix covers unary, streaming, duplex and shared shapes, transparent retries, max-concurrent-stream admission, end-stream error suppression, and the health Watch gate/read-retention cases. No source change was required for this run.
